versions.content: On reception of a request for UDS Service InputOutputCon- trolByIdentifier (0x2F) with inputOutputControlParameter equal to freezeCur- rentState, the Dcm module shall invoke all impacted configured function of the controlEnableMaskRecord (if parameter DcmDspDataUsePort set to USE_DATA_- SYNCH_FNC or USE_DATA_ASYNCH_FNC or USE_DATA_ASYNCH_FNC_ERROR ; see configuration parameter DcmDspDataFreezeCurrentStateFnc ).
